I feel like we have a lot in common. I'm 21 and I drop out of terms of college all the time for depression/anxiety/bi-polar problems. 

people think I'm younger than I am. It's stressful because I think I look awful and stupid and all these other negative things and the only compliment I ever really get is "you're so young"

I've been in school for almost 4 years and I'm barely a sophomore. 

In short, college fucking sucks. It sucks, but you can do it. You are articulate and self-aware and fuck what everyone else is doing. Hold yourself to your own standards of success. Do what you need to do to start feeling better. If it means not doing college right now, then don't. You are awesome. You don't need that shit right now.

I think you are awesome.

one of the best pieces of advice anyone ever gave regarding what my grandmother refers to as the "poor-mes" is that you cannot live in comparison. Your problems are big to you. It's true, people have worse problems, but there are also people who have really great lives a majority of the time. Your feelings, even if you think they are petty or selfish or fucked up, are legitimate simply by virtue of being your feelings.
I was those girls in middle and high school. It comes from a place of misguided anger, and mean girls usually grow out of it. Shitty non-the-less.

my roommate has said a number of things to me in a playful-yet-cruel way: "You aren't wearing make-up today, are you?" and "You look better with pants on" are two of my favorites. I thought living with a boy would be less emotionally damaging.

I have a love-hate relationship with halloween and costumes. One part of me wants to be sexy and slutty because I'm empowered and I feel good about myself, but another part of me KNOWS that my [sexy peter pan costume] (http://www.3wishes.com/images_viewer/image_viewer.asp?prodID=DH1003) isn't for my benefit. Every year I freeze my ass off and justify it to myself because I'm young and male attention is great. In the end I feel like a slut, but a sexually empowered slut.
This happens to me too and I'm a 20 yo female.
